				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
									<p>Discover a<strong> unique stay in Tarifa</strong> at our Surf House, located in the vibrant heart of the city! Just steps away from the iconic Puerta de Jerez and a minute from <strong>El Balneario</strong> beach, our location is unbeatable. Enjoy Tarifa&#8217;s lively nightlife with a variety of bars, restaurants, and chill-outs just minutes away, but without sacrificing tranquility! Our house offers a peaceful retreat from the downtown noise, ensuring you a restful break and the opportunity to appreciate stunning sunsets.</p><p>It&#8217;s a very bright duplex with views of the sea and Africa, with several balconies overlooking the Strait and the castle of Tarifa. Each of our rooms is designed to provide you with comfort and brightness, with high-quality beds to ensure you optimal rest. With free Wi-Fi and a fully equipped kitchen at your disposal, you&#8217;ll feel at home from the moment you arrive. Additionally, our Surf House has ample space to store your kitesurfing or surfing equipment, conveniently located at street level for your convenience. Get ready for an unparalleled experience in Tarifa at our Surf House, where comfort and adventure come together in perfect harmony!</p>								</div>
